description.value: Thierry is a renowned Vancouver patisserie and chocolaterie founded by Chef Thierry Busset, a maitre artisan Chocolatier and Patissier who previously worked at three Michelin-starred London restaurants including Le Gavroche. The Alberni Street flagship is located in the heart of downtown Vancouver and offers handcrafted chocolates, macarons, pastries, cakes, and breakfast and lunch items in an elegant setting. It is one of three Vancouver locations and has been widely recognized as among North America's finest pastry establishments.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 63m; stands (3 spaces) at 67m; stands (5 spaces) at 82m. Total: 13 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, multi-location patisserie and café at 1059 Alberni Street, consistent with the OSM record. The OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes is corroborated by the vegetarian-compatible menu items visible on the website; the site also prominently features 'Order Now' and 'ORDER ONLINE' calls-to-action confirming takeout/online ordering. No bicycle-specific amenities, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM phone field is empty; phone number 604 608 6870 was sourced from the website's Alberni location listing and added to this record.
OSM opening hours may not match current website hours — website shows slightly different times (e.g. Alberni: Sun–Thu 8am–10pm, Fri–Sat 8am–11pm) than OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, highly regarded downtown Vancouver café with indoor and outdoor seating, takeout, and vegetarian options — a strong stop for touring cyclists passing through the city centre.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business operates three Vancouver locations (Alberni, Mount Pleasant, Ambleside); this record corresponds to the Alberni Street flagship only.
